title: Official avalanche accident records
note: Links only. The app does not copy accident records: CAIC's terms prohibit robots and data mining and require prior written permission to reproduce its materials. These pages are the authoritative source; show them from any place, route or incident view.

links.title: CAIC: Colorado avalanche accidents
links.contains: Table of Colorado accidents (date, location name, level of involvement, severity, caught, buried, injured, killed, description) with a link to each report. URL filters work, for example ?from=2024-10-01&to=2026-09-30&fatal=1. No map, no coordinates, no export. Coverage statements conflict: the page says 1949-1950 to the current avalanche year, the help page says 2019-2020 onward; records from 1951 are returned.

links.title: CAIC: US fatal avalanche accidents
links.contains: Table of fatal avalanche accidents in the United States, compiled by CAIC.

links.title: CAIC: accident statistics and reporting
links.contains: US and Colorado fatality tables by season, state, month and activity (1950-51 to 2025-26), and a link to the full US fatal accident dataset as an Excel file (CAIC asks to be cited).

links.title: CAIC: accident table help
links.contains: Definitions of the accident table fields and categories.

links.title: CAIC experimental product: Colorado avalanche fatalities since 1861
links.contains: County-level choropleth map of fatalities, avalanche years 1861 to 2025 (embeds accidents.avalanche.state.co.us/historic-fatalities/). Counties, not points; no download.

links.title: CAIC accident report (example: Resolution Creek, 2026-03-07)
links.contains: Individual report pages follow https://avalanche.state.co.us/reports/canonical/{uuid}: status (Preliminary Information or Final Report), published date, narrative, avalanche coding, photos, a map with Lat/Lon to 3 decimals. The page does not say what the point marks or how precise it is.

links.title: CAIC Avalanche Explorer
links.contains: Interactive map of avalanche observations (not an accident layer). It did not initialise in a headless browser test on 2026-11-06, so its contents are unverified.

links.title: Avalanche.org: US avalanche accidents
links.contains: US fatal accidents from 2009-2010 onward (date, state, location, summary, fatalities), compiled by CAIC and the National Avalanche Center from the CAIC database. Rejects plain curl requests (HTTP 403); loads in a browser.

links.title: CAIC terms of use
links.contains: Robots and data-mining prohibition; reproduction requires CAIC's prior written permission.

links.title: CAIC contact, data and API access requests
links.contains: Request for API Access form for apps built on CAIC data, a Request for Data form, caic@state.co.us.
